notes.title: You can play the latest Demo at Master of Piece: Prologue!
notes.content: [p]Hello Commanders! [/p][p][/p][p]We want to sincerely thank everyone who has played and supported the [b]Master of Piece Demo[/b] since its release. Your feedback and encouragement have been invaluable to us in shaping the game.[/p][p][/p][p]As we move forward, we will be [b]closing the Demo on the Steam page for now[/b] as it is outdated. But don’t worry — you can continue your journey in the [b]Prologue[/b], which now contains the [b]latest demo build with much more content[/b]. It has been released last month during Gamescom, so it is our second demo build with improved and augmented content since the first Demo that we released here, in March.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700250/Master_of_Piece_Prologue/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]The Prologue is completely free to play and represents the newest direction of the game. We’d love for you to try it out, leave us your thoughts, and add the full game to your wishlist if you haven’t already.[/p]

notes.title: Prologue 1.3.15 Patch Note
notes.content: [p]Hello Master of Piece players, this is I M GAME.[/p][p]Since the release of the Prologue, we’ve received a tremendous amount of valuable feedback from players.[/p][p]Among them, we selected the issues that required the most urgent improvements and reflected them in this update.[/p][p]Feedback that has not yet been addressed will be implemented gradually during Early Access, so we look forward to your continued opinions and feedback.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700250/_/"][/dynamiclink][/p][h3]System Changes[/h3][list][*][p]Mercenary movement using Action Points has been adjusted from “unlimited” to “adjacent 1 tile.”[/p][/*][*][p]4x3 and 4x5 battle tiles have been removed.[/p][/*][*][p]Rewards for street battles have been changed from “Trait Rewards” to “Mercenary Rewards.”[/p][/*][*][p]The building event “Inn” has been changed to “Trait Shop.”[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]UI / UX Improvements[/h3][list][*][p]You can now claim rewards in building events and post-battle victory screens by clicking on the target.[/p][/*][*][p]When selecting rumors at the Tavern, one of the three must now always be assigned to a mercenary.[/p][/*][*][p]When enhancing traits, you can now preview the enhanced trait without placing a mercenary.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Difficulty Adjustment[/h3][list][*][p]Hardship Stage 2[/p][list][*][p]Before: Boss health increases.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Boss health and [b]attack[/b] increase.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Balance[/h3][list][*][p]Traits[/p][list][*][p]Riposte[/p][list][*][p]Before: When you survive after being hit, counterattack and deal damage equal to your remaining health. Gain +1 health if this counterattack defeats an enemy.[/p][/*][*][p]After: When you survive after being hit, counterattack and deal damage equal to your remaining health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Preemptive Defense[/p][list][*][p]Before: Before the ally’s flag is attacked through an empty tile, move in front of the enemy attacking the flag and gain +2 health at the end of the round.[/p][/*][*][p]After: Before the ally’s flag is attacked through an empty tile, [b]move in front of the enemy attacking the flag and gain +2 health. (Max 4)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Restoration[/p][list][*][p]Before: At the end of each round, gain +1 health. If you took damage in the previous round, gain an additional +1 health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: At the end of each round, gain +1 health. [b](Max 4)[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fighting Spirit[/p][list][*][p]Before: When you survive after taking damage, gain +1 attack and +1 health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: When you survive after taking damage, gain [b]+1 attack.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Lifesteal[/p][list][*][p]Before: Whenever an enemy mercenary is killed, fully restore lost health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: [b]Once per battle,[/b] when killing an enemy mercenary, fully restore lost health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Resentment[/p][list][*][p]Before: While on the battlefield, gain +1 attack each time you or an ally takes damage.[/p][/*][*][p]After: While on the battlefield, [b]gain +1 attack each time another allied mercenary takes damage.[/b][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Relics[/p][list][*][p]Guardian’s Emblem[/p][list][*][p]Before: At the end of each round, all allies recover 1 lost health.[/p][/*][*][p]After: At the end of each round, 1 random ally recovers 1 lost health.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #8: Sigmund's Relics
notes.content: [p]Greetings, this is I M GAME.[/p][p][/p][p]In this devlog, we would like to introduce [b]the three relics of Sigmund, [/b]which you will be able to choose before embarking on your journey, in the Prologue version.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Sigmund's Relics[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Sigmund sold off many heirlooms of the Eagle family to raise funds after its decline.[/p][p]However, the three relics introduced here were deemed too valuable in power to be sold, and will instead aid him on his journey to restore the family's honor.[/p][p][/p][h3]1. The first relic is [b]Commander's Sword[/b] — a blade that echoed the will of a fallen house and led its remnants through countless battles.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/654fc14d5ad02dc62bc89deb7a2a4bef23fb61da.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]With just its tip raised, the sword exudes an overwhelming presence — enough to drive enemies back with ease.[/p][p][/p][p]When Sigmund commands with this mighty blade, allied morale surges, granting increased attack power every time a mercenary is moved twice.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/b5c6fceb2f8e0635a26b082e9595a9987967ebcc.gif"][/img][/p][p]After repositioning a mercenary to trigger the Commander's Sword, the soldier strikes with overwhelming force, cutting down his foes in a single blow.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3]2. The second is the [b]Helm of Wind[/b] — a relic that aided numerous mercenaries.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/fc504c8143fea94753fd89d6826707f954b90a53.png"][/img][/p][p]When wind flows through its crest, those behind move with newfound lightness.[/p][p]By holding the front line, Sigmund steadily accelerates the speed of his allies.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/b715a448adf1b5288e668b0127373955d4857fea.gif"][/img][/p][p]With the Helm of Wind steadily boosting speed, mercenaries will swiftly overwhelm his enemies.[/p][p][/p][h3]3. The third is a [b]Deep Blue Cloak[/b], light and soft to the touch.[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/28dc51d05cc1a76314b4eb999318c0951f50c1f5.png"][/img][/p][p]Its softness is astonishing to all who touch it.[/p][p][/p][p]Even when struck by blades, the cloak neither tears nor falters — instead, it deflects the edge with uncanny ease.[/p][p][/p][p]Sigmund uses this unique fabric to shield his banner from enemy attacks, turning defense into silent defiance.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/62a918d03e8071d195bc039180e700cad72894ec.gif"][/img][/p][p]When enemies have higher speed, the Deep Blue Cloak turns the tide — paving the way for a hard-won victory.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b] [/h3][p][/p][p]Sigmund’s relics play a pivotal role throughout the journey, offering a range of strategic options.[/p][p]With each run shaped by different relics, players can look forward to a diverse and ever-changing experience.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue polishing and expanding [i]Master of Piece[/i] while keeping its unique charm intact.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback through our [url="https://discord.gg/"]Discord[/url] or the Steam discussion page.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below![/b][/p][p][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #7: Prophet of the Sun
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/1f44e4edddc88fe6293ba4f324ce5730c97601ad.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Greetings. This is I M GAME.[/p][p][/p][p]A new threat emerges in [i]Master of Piece[/i].[/p][p]In the scorching desert, the Prophet of the Sun continues his search for a way to harness the power of sunlight through endless research.[/p][p][/p][p]In this devlog, we introduce the identity of this enigmatic leader and his unique combat abilities.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The One who Wields the Power of Light[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/d86c362571ee9f5fb42045bd38f52fc42bd58c61.gif"][/img][/p][p]For the Order of the Sun, light is more than a natural phenomenon—it is a sacred manifestation of the Sun’s will.[/p][p]
The Prophet of the Sun has long received revelations through light, dedicating himself to uncovering its truth.[/p][p][/p][p]As a result, he has acquired the ability to mark and create an explosion of light, wielding techniques that are impossible to predict.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/27e8bc5adedc523d18d179414fcc21aca71d12de.gif"][/img][/p][p]He carves radiant marks and detonates them, delivering punishment to his enemies and blessings to his allies.
With this power, he dominates the battlefield like a deity, instilling fear in all who face him.[/p][p][/p][p]Because of the overwhelming nature of the light, he always wears a mask to avoid being consumed by it.
Few have ever seen his face, and even his tone and demeanor reveal little emotion.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Minions who protect the Light[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/f7841d90e5a1fc29c61f07359ea873760989d0ea.gif"][/img][/p][p]The Prophet is accompanied by loyal servants who protect the sanctity of light.[/p][p]They devote themselves to protecting the light, at all costs.[/p][p][/p][p]As long as the Prophet supports them, they have nothing to fear.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Once the prologue is released, players will need to extinguish the Prophet’s light.[/p][p]You cannot afford to ignore the radiant marks.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue polishing and expanding [i]Master of Piece[/i] while keeping its unique charm intact.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback through our [url="https://discord.gg/"]Discord[/url] or the Steam discussion page.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below![/b][/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #6: Leader of the Sun
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/e4806e9f4ad30b9832e772d0579617a768d8ea05.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings. This is I M GAME.[/p][p][/p][p]A new threat emerges in [i]Master of Piece[/i].[/p][p]In the searing heat of the desert, [b]the Leader of the Sun[/b] seeks forbidden knowledge and protects his stronghold with loyal followers. [/p][p]In this devlog, we introduce the appearance and combat style of this formidable boss.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The One who relentlessly seeks knowledge[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/98cc8fc9455473a2718124064f345d86b1183a2f.gif"][/img][/p][p]Driven by a mad obsession to obtain all of the world’s knowledge and truth, [b]the Leader of the Sun[/b] has devoted his life to relentless study. [/p][p][/p][p]Now, he uses the wisdom he has accumulated to defend his fortress and carry on the will of the sun.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/ec2c6a69831324dd90189379fd52d9a82b85be9e.gif"][/img][/p][p]He is an enemy equipped with a strong blow that gathers knowledge in various ways and unleashes it in a single, devastating attack.[/p][p]As if to prove the phrase “knowledge is power,” he bestows divine judgment to keep the players –intruders to him – at bay.[/p][p]His appearance reflects a lifetime of scholarship—neatly worn robes, wrinkles carved with wisdom, a white turban, and a well-worn tome always at his side.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Minions to Share his Wisdom[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/30ca50e69c28644b3d12c76865e58f0cbbc71c31.gif"][/img][/p][p]To [b]the Leader of the Sun[/b], knowledge is also meant to be shared. His followers pass along what they learn, growing stronger with the wisdom granted from their leader.[/p][p]This strong mentorship between the leader and followers will be growing threat to your expedition as the battle persists.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To withstand his divine judgment, players will need to find ways to distract him from seeking the truth.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue polishing and expanding [i]Master of Piece[/i] while keeping its unique charm intact.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback through our [url="https://discord.gg/"]Discord[/url] or the Steam discussion page.[/p][p][b]Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below![/b][/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece: Prologue Launches August 22 – Play It First at Gamescom!
notes.content:
[p]Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans! [/p][p]Today we have 2 big announcements to share.[/p][p]Thank you for playing our demo since March, and thank you for the patience for waiting until the full release![/p][p][/p][p]To thank you for all of your support, we are happy to announce: [/p][p][/p][h3][b]Master of Piece: Prologue will be released on August 22nd!🎉[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/05b46b13244199a0fba87fc7c4f25a7da1f0c987.jpg"][/img][/p][h3][/h3][h3]👇Go to Master of Piece: Prologue Page[/h3][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700250"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]《Master of Piece: Prologue》 is a [b]free[/b] prologue version of 《Master of Piece》, which will be released in August 22nd, on a separate store page.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/a68607344ed0b60be47edc87fa4456d7e0341368.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Purpose of the Prologue Version[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Since launching the demo in March, over 10,000 players have downloaded our game, and many have provided valuable feedback to various parts of the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Thanks to all the feedback we’ve received since the demo’s release, we’ve been able to improve many aspects of the game. We’re truly grateful for the opportunity to communicate with our players and see the game make progress because of it.[/p][/*][*][p]Recognizing how essential user feedback is to creating a quality gaming experience, we’ve decided to boldly implement features that, if not for the Prologue, would have been considered only internally—and observe how players respond.[/p][/*][*][p]The Prologue will function as a kind of test, helping us determine which features should make it into the final version based on community feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/da6e4fbbc263c15d714a12361ad99092f2422400.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Prologue Features[/b][/h3][p]Aside from the Demo that we have released in March, here are the new features that are added in this Free Prologue Version:[/p][list][*][p][b]New region - The Blazing Sands [/b] 
The 2nd region will be open to play in the Prologue! 
New region, new enemies, new facilities, new card events and… New Bosses![/p][/*][*][p][b]New Main Lobby system [/b]
The new game lobby now provides a more immersive game experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Trait Upgrade System [/b] 
You can now upgrade your favorite traits and cherish even more powerful trait abilities![/p][/*][*][p][b]Commander Level Progress[/b]  
You can gain experience through journeys and Unlock new content through leveling up.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Customizable Mercenary presets [/b] 
Start your expedition by customizing the commander's ability, starting relic and mercenary party of your choice.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]But that’s not all — we’re also bringing the prologue to[b] [/b][/h3][h3][b]Gamescom 2025, starting August 20![/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/fb4ebd206014435e8ffe6259d780721e9ef53fd7.jpg"][/img][/p][p]We’ll be showcasing the prologue [b]live at Gamescom[/b] from [b]August 20–24[/b]. Come by our booth to play, chat with the team, and grab some exclusive goodies![/p][p][/p][h3][b]🗓️ Save the Date[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Prologue Release on Steam:[/b] August 22[/p][/*][*][p][b]Gamescom 2025:[/b] August 20–24[/p][/*][/list][p]Make sure to [b]wishlist[/b] the full game.[/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the Prologue release![/p][p][/p][p][url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3700250" style="button"]Go to Master of Piece: Prologue Page[/url][/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #5: Improving User Experience
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/4d2548edc665f09e3a468faa3d06a33b4217f85b.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Greetings. This is I M GAME.[/p][p]To offer a smoother gameplay experience, we’ve been working to improve various systems in Master of Piece.[/p][p]In this devlog, we’d like to share the latest changes to how your journey begins—with a reworked game flow and the introduction of a new central space: the [b]Departure Grounds[/b].[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A New Lobby System[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/5bfef3a90e1c1253040104d30f362c5ca0463290.gif"][/img][/p][p]At the start of each game—or once your journey ends—your commander will now appear in the center of the Departure Grounds.[/p][p]We’ve also added the ability to directly control your commander, bringing more immersion to the game and reinforcing one of Master of Piece’s core features: moving your mercenaries manually.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Departure Grounds[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/595306764a1c7b4d9f36aa71476c4c97488a2928.gif"][/img][/p][p]In previous versions, the starting screen was filled with black smoke and had no real interactive elements. Buttons looked inconsistent, and the rules of each system weren’t unified—making the game harder to learn for new players.[/p][p]To solve this, we’ve redesigned the area into a consolidated space: the [b]Departure Grounds[/b].[/p][p]Before heading out on a new journey, you’ll now move your commander through this shared hub to prepare—leveling up, modifying traits, or adjusting your team before stepping into the fog.[/p][p]This update reduces wasted space and ties all pre-journey activities into a single, unified experience.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]No More Screen Transitions[/b][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/16f7d1b51e736a48e13c9a02393edeba67c6a0d8.gif"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/96663ec5057e3cd0e3b81519b1a7d4b23f537b0d.gif"][/img][/p][p]Previously, moving between different areas—whether inside or outside—always triggered a loading transition.[/p][p]After the update, movement between [i]external[/i] locations will now happen seamlessly, with no screen change.[/p][p]Only when entering a building will the scene transition, creating a clearer contrast between indoor and outdoor areas while improving the gaming experience and flow.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]This update focuses less on changing core gameplay, and more on enhancing the game’s quality-of-life and overall immersion.[/p][p][/p][p]By improving the flow and cohesiveness of the early-game experience, we hope to help more players get invested—and see their journey through to the end.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ll continue polishing and expanding Master of Piece while keeping its unique charm intact.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback through our Discord or the Steam discussion page. [/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below![/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #4: The Blazing Sands
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/04c6d94183329cec5eb7fb6a160c89565de5fa66.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Greetings. This is I M GAME.[/p][p][/p][p]A new region is coming to [b]Master of Piece.[/b][/p][p]It’s known for its scorching heat and vast, open landscape.[/p][p]In this devlog, we introduce this new land that awaits beyond the Sunlit Hills.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Blazing Sands[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/3376dda5597ce865994c2f0c2dd0f09746ffd28a.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Beyond the Hill of Sunshine lies the Desert, waiting for your expedition.[/p][p]Before the black fog consumed the world, this land basked in the full heat of the sun—earning it the name [i]the Blazing Sands.[/i][/p][p]The Blazing Sands are vast, with repeating landscapes that makes confusing for travelers.[/p][p]Crossing the desert alone is perilous, and even experienced merchants often find themselves straying into unfamiliar paths.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]About the Desert[/b][/h3][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/584e818ddfb4dd248f57b449bde65383c851b49e.gif"][/img][/h3][p]While exploring the Blazing Sands, you may come across an abandoned temple.[/p][p]Though long forgotten, rumors say that those who offer a prayer there may receive a small blessing.[/p][p][/p][p]Scattered throughout the desert are mysterious statues of unknown origin.[/p][p]Their purpose remains unclear, but they serve as reliable guides for those traversing the sands.[/p][p]Among them, the most well-known is the Statue of the Goddess at the heart of the desert—regarded by many travelers as a symbol of fortune.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]The Citadel of Wisdom[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/170d556d05815764770190af5bd4671b51bbdbc3.gif"][/img][/p][p]In the Blazing Sands, there exists a group as intense as the scorching sun itself.[/p][p][/p][p]They are known as the [i][b]Order of the Sun[/b][/i], worshippers of the sun.[/p][p]Driven by an obsession—and perhaps madness—they follow the creed: [i][b]“The Sun knows all.”[/b][/i][/p][p]To fulfill what they believe is the will of the sun, they collect and preserve all knowledge of the world.[/p][p][/p][p]But with so much to protect, they have grown deeply secretive.[/p][p]They move through the desert in shadows, rarely showing themselves.[/p][p]Sometimes, they lure travelers with jars of water—only to rob them of books, food, and supplies to sustain their order.[/p][p][/p][p]And yet, despite their reclusive nature, they should never be underestimated.[/p][p]With the power of their knowledge—and of the sun itself—they will stand in the expedition’s way, striking back with unrelenting force.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Conclusion[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]To make it through the newly added Blazing Sands, players will need to be fully prepared to take on the Order of the Sun.[/p][p]We’ll continue refining our systems while preserving the unique charm of [i][b]Master of Piece[/b][/i], aiming to deliver a deeply satisfying experience for all players.[/p][p]We’d love to hear your feedback through our Discord or the Steam discussion page.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below![/b][/p]

notes.title: Master of Piece Devlog #3: Dragon Cult Commander and His Minions
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/39a554265ac431ff8081ecac6ff16baa8bcdecc4.png[/img]
Greetings. This is I M GAME.
A new menace rises within Master of Piece.
Upon the sunlit hills, the Dragon Cult Commander marches forth with blasphemous chants, rallying his knightly order for war.
In this dev diary, we unveil his identity and his nature in battle.

[h2]A Boss Who Commands an Army[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/146171e1fe631632bbcba37ca18f080b9d993d55.gif[/img]
Gripped by twisted longing, the Dragon Cult Commander is a cold and calculating general who cares little for the lives of his own men.
Through methodical troop deployment and devastating strikes, he fights to secure the survival of his cult—and to fulfill the truths of the dragon faith.

He is a Boss who grows stronger the more he is wounded, passing that strength down to his subordinates.
Should a Mercenary dare deliver the final blow, they will be met with a punishing counterattack, one fierce enough to tip the tide of battle in an instant.

His appearance evokes the commanding presence of a true war leader.
Encased in full plate armor, wielding a greatsword, and crowned with a horned great helm—he is no mere knight, but something far more dire.

[h2]Minions Loyal to Their Commander[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/0a38e12ab36890e63f1ad92b2e9de311699e0fb6.png[/img]
The Commander’s minions obey without hesitation.
They fight as one, weaving powerful synergies that drive the expedition ever closer to ruin.

[h2]Conclusion[/h2]

To stand against the new threat of the upcoming Dragon Cult Commander, players will need even more refined strategies.
We will continue to refine the systems of Master of Piece while preserving the game’s unique identity.
Please share your thoughts through Discord or the Steam discussion page.
Thank you.

notes.title: Master of Devlogs #2: Elite Battles and Boss Battles, Revamped!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/9fd3125f48cdc72f0627cf19c9c24f6d6d44656e.jpg[/img]

Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!
In our previous dev diary, we introduced the [b]Mercenary Movement[/b] and [b]Action Points[/b] systems.
Today, we’re excited to share details about the newly improved [b]Boss Battle[/b] system.

[h2]Same Victory Conditions across All Battles[/h2]

In the new Boss Battle, the Boss replaces the fortress position. Just like regular battles, victory is achieved by destroying the enemy’s base.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/cd574e2e3532f3d6c08c78174ca3afd385bc5cc7.gif[/img]

Previously, the Boss moved left and right to attack the player (like one of the mercenaries). The victory condition was defeating the Boss, not destroying the Flag or Fortress.

However, this created problems as the Victory Condition was different from other battles. The Boss also moved around in the battlefield, which made it difficult for players to utilize the mercenaries at the right places and timings. We assessed that this was far from Master of Piece’s design philosophy of simple rules and synergistic gameplay.

Thus, to provide players with a consistent learning experience across all battles while preserving the unique fun of Boss Battles, we merged the Boss and the fortress into one.

Now that the Boss can be attacked from all tiles, players can fully execute the builds and strategies that they have devised in regular battles.

At the same time, we also worked to make Boss patterns more distinct and diverse.
Next, we’d like to introduce the newly enhanced [b]“Boss Attack Pattern Diversification”[/b].

[h2]Boss Attack Pattern Diversification[/h2]

The Boss now features more threatening and unique traits, utilizing a variety of combat patterns to pressure players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/da2d960248ee8b9f63883ed7052b2d0bb32fa380.gif[/img]

Previously, the Boss had a simple pattern—moving left and right and attacking only under specific conditions.

With this update, the Boss has become a more dynamic and formidable foe.
Players will need to identify the Boss’s patterns and devise their own strategies to overcome the battle.
Flexible decision making would be necessary, based on your Mercenary and trait combinations and the current battle situation.

We’ve also made changes to the enemy Mercenaries that appear in the battles.

[h2]Unique Traits for Enemy Mercenaries[/h2]

Enemy Mercenaries deployed in Elite and Boss Battles now come with their own unique traits.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/7fac545d07bcdc7c5a3cdebee5a68e99c4699960.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/bd7173db62a8993940a9fb8d6f933ccf6f59e91c.gif[/img]

These Mercenaries can create synergy by protecting or empowering one another, becoming powerful reinforcements for the Boss. Players cannot obtain these unique traits from the players' side.

Below are some examples of how the new Boss Battle and Mercenary Movement systems actually work:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/31f7fe344af73b7eaf658124bf55f76138c399f7.gif[/img]

The Boss does not move but attacks and activates its traits from a fixed position.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/fb11c50fdf2a69e19da99b679ba455c04339a9fd.gif[/img]

Before the attack, you can check the tiles targeted by the Boss’s special attack, then spend enough Action Points to move your Mercenary and dodge the attack.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

The improved Boss Battle system lets players execute their strategies more effectively, while reinforcing the Boss to make it even more formidable.

Additionally, a variety of randomly selected Elite and Boss Battles will be added to each journey through future updates.
We hope this will stimulate players’ desire to take on new challenges and offer a tense and rewarding experience in every battle.
We will continue to refine the system so that more players can enjoy it, all while preserving the unique charm of Master of Piece.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Master of Devlogs #1: Mercenary Movement and Action Points
notes.content:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

Since the release of our demo, we have continuously improved the game based on valuable feedback from many players.

As part of these improvements, we’d like to introduce two new core systems: [b]Mercenary Movement[/b] and [b]Action Points[/b].

[h2]Mercenary Movement[/h2]

Players can now freely change the tile position of deployed mercenaries.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/2510848ce1eed58d20ff77ff6f26238871a7bcde.gif[/img]

In the previous battle system, once a mercenary was deployed, players could not change its position. The unit would simply advance forward and attack the enemy right at the front.

We have received a lot of feedback from players saying, “There's not much to do during the battles,” or “It would be nice to have more strategic influence over battles.”

To make combat more dynamic, we’ve introduced a new system that allows players to reposition the ones that are already deployed.

With this change, players can now move mercenaries to target enemy flags, or reposition them to engage with enemies they are more effective against, resulting in a more flexible and strategic battle experience.


However, mercenaries cannot be repositioned at any time without cost.
To reposition a mercenary, you’ll need to use [b]Action Points[/b], which we’ll explain below.

[h2]Action Points[/h2]

Deploying or repositioning mercenaries now requires Action Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/8922c04f84f166d5a099fc701b91cfdb0c283bb5.png[/img]

At the start of a battle, players receive 3 Action Points. After that, 2 points will be given to the player at the start of each round.

Unused points will remain between rounds, and players can store up to 4 Action Points.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/148e4c79b253458ce4fba0a53c39c43cf79c09d8.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/1beed8aac422b9068f679a42250de1e273853d3d.gif[/img]

Deploying a new mercenary costs 2 Action Points, while repositioning an already deployed unit costs 1 Action Point.

This system gives players multiple strategic options—whether to deploy one mercenary and move another, or deploy two mercenaries, or simply move several at once, depending on the situation and remaining action points.


Below are some examples of how these two systems work together during actual gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/11b276dcf27ec0c1f46e2534b30cb137a6e8835e.gif[/img]
Two enemy units are about to attack the player’s flag, but by deploying and repositioning existing units, the player completely blocks the threat.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/2281515c4feed31f1c42e0886c7b31a9302c356c.gif[/img]
Deploying two mercenaries in one round creates a powerful synergy effect.

[h2]What’s Next[/h2]

These two new systems expand the existing battle mechanics by introducing new layers of strategy—players must now read the situation of the battlefield and manage their Action Points wisely.

We hope this update will satisfy both players who enjoy fast, intuitive combat and those who prefer deeper strategic gameplay.

Going forward, we will continue refining the system while preserving the unique charm of [b]Master of Piece[/b] to create a game experience that satisfies even more players.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: Demo 1.1.0 Update
notes.content:
Greetings to all of our Master of Piece fans!

Today, we are pleased to present the 1.1.0 update, which address issues discovered after the 1.0.3 patch. This update includes fixes for reported issues, as well as improvements based on your feedback to enhance the overall gameplay experience.

[General]
• Added French, German, Spanish, Russian, and Italian (temporary translations).
• Improved performance to ensure the game runs smoothly in the background.

[Gameplay]
• Added a cost system in battles. 
• The cost system now allows players to change the positions of mercenaries deployed during battles.
• Improved the boss battle logic to ensure that no mercenaries are left unused.
• Corrected the information displayed for upgrades at the Shaman’s Hut.
• Modified the system to allow players to select which mercenary will receive random positive rumors.
• Improved the layout of some UI elements for a more intuitive screen design.
• Ensured that even empty traits and rumor slots are displayed in the mercenary info UI.

[Bug Fixes]
• Fixed a bug where the Enter key did not work correctly when set as a shortcut.
• Fixed a bug where the trait 'Combat Readiness' and the relic 'Iron Cross' was activated before the first round of battle.
• Fixed a bug where some relic effects obtained through card events did not activate.
• Fixed a bug where drag-and-drop mercenary deployment during battles did not function correctly.
• Fixed a bug where battle items could not be obtained in the bookstore.
• Fixed a bug where graphic settings changed on its own.

Stay tuned for more updates, and connect with us in our Discord and social media below!

notes.title: A playable Demo will be released in 12th March!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45066140/24dbf23a0dfbd42f44e82bd58d7ab38d68a59ead.jpg[/img]

Greetings to all of our Master Piece fans!

We’ve got not just one, but two big announcements to share with you today!

[h1]🧱 A New Name, Same Great Adventure!
[/h1]
After listening to your feedback and reflecting on how best to present our game to the world, we’ve decided to change the title of our game [b]from Master Piece to Master of Piece.[/b] The previous name made it a bit tricky to find in search results, and we wanted to make sure nothing stood between you and the world we’ve been building. We believe this new name better reflects the heart of our game and will make it easier for you to dive into the adventure!

[h1]🎮 Playable Demo Arriving March 12th![/h1]
We’re thrilled to announce that a playable demo of Master of Piece will be available on March 12th! In this demo, you’ll embark on a journey through Region 1: Hill of Sunshine, where cultists whisper of a dragon’s rebirth and danger lurks around every corner.

To ensure you experience the full potential of our game, we’ve carefully selected a roster of mercenaries designed to offer maximum entertainment. Every decision, every roll of the dice, and every battle will pull you deeper into the strategic and immersive experience we’ve crafted.

Thank you to everyone who has supported us so far. We can’t wait for you to experience what we’ve been working on and to hear your thoughts!

Stay tuned for more updates as we get closer to the demo release.

notes.title: Master Piece Conclusion of the 2nd Global CBT End
notes.content:
Hello from I M GAME,
We would like to thank everyone for their support in making our second Closed Beta Test a success.
We received more applications than expected, and while we're grateful for the interest, we regret that we couldn’t accommodate everyone.

We are always committed to listening to your feedback. Please feel free to share your honest thoughts, whether they are positive or areas for improvement.
- Feedback Survey: https://forms.gle/sESx8yMHRURPvfHm9


If you’re interested, you can join our Discord to communicate with the developers and other players.
- Discord: https://discord.gg/q2Qd7jgU


We hope you'll continue to accompany us on the journey as Master Piece evolves. Thank you once again.

notes.title: Random Selection Process for Master Piece CBT Testers
notes.content:
Hello!

For the current CBT conducted via [b]Steam Playtest[/b], all testers are selected completely at [b]random.[/b]The only control we have is deciding the total number of participants to approve. Unfortunately, we do not have the ability to hand-pick individual users.

Initially, we planned to randomly select [b]100[/b] testers each from Korea and the U.S. However, due to the overwhelming interest, we extended the selection by adding [b]50[/b] more testers each from the additional applications received by [b]November 6 (Wed).[/b]

No further selections will be made until the CBT ends on [b]November 13 (Wed).[/b] We sincerely thank all the users who showed interest and applied. 🙏

We will reflect the valuable feedback received during this CBT and aim to present an even better game in the next CBT or during the Early Access phase.

Thank you!

notes.title: Extension of Master Piece CBT Period
notes.content:
Hello, this is I M GAME. 
Due to numerous requests from testers, we have decided to extend the current CBT (Closed Beta Test) period. Please see the updated schedule for Korea and the U.S. below. 

[b]Original CBT Period[/b]
* Korea (KST): November 4, 2024 (Mon) 15:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 17:00
* U.S. (EST): November 4, 2024 (Sun) 02:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 04:00

[b]Extended CBT Period[/b]
* Korea (KST): November 4, 2024 (Mon) 15:00 ~ [b]November 13, 2024 (Wed) 17:00[/b]
* U.S. (EST): November 4, 2024 (Sun) 02:00 ~ [b]November 13, 2024 (Wed) 04:00[/b]

We sincerely thank all the testers for their enthusiastic participation and kindly ask for even more feedback during the extended period! Thank you.

notes.title: Master Piece 2nd Global CBT Begins
notes.content:
Hello, we are Team I M GAME.

To ensure a smoother and more enjoyable CBT experience, we have decided to [b]reschedule the test start time to 02:00 (EST) on Monday, November 4, 2024.[/b]
Join us on the journey of Master Piece, featuring new items, traits, and enhanced systems and content!

We would appreciate your feedback via [Library - Master Piece Playtest - Write a Review on Steam] or through our [Discord Feedback Channel].
[list]
[*] Discord URL: [url=https://discord.gg/b5zcqJYb]https://discord.gg/b5zcqJYb[/url]
[/list]
If you encounter any bugs during gameplay, please report them through [ESC - Report Bug - Write Details] or use the [Discord Bug Report Channel].


Please send us your honest opinions. We carefully review each piece of feedback to help make Master Piece even better.
[list]
[*] Survey URL: [url=https://forms.gle/sESx8yMHRURPvfHm9]https://forms.gle/sESx8yMHRURPvfHm9[/url]
[/list][u]The survey link also appears in-game.[/u]


We’ve prepared a special event: after the test ends, we will randomly select 20 people who include their email addresses in the survey to receive official Steam keys upon release.


[b]Test Period[/b]
- Korea (KST): November 4, 2024 (Mon) 15:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 17:00
- U.S. (EST): November 4, 2024 (Sun) 02:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 04:00

[b]Add Wishlist[/b] and [b]following[/b] give great support to the developers!

Thank you very much.

notes.title: Master Piece 2nd Global CBT Tester Recruitment
notes.content:
Hello, we are the I M GAME team from Master Piece.

After receiving a lot of feedback from users during the first CBT, we have made many improvements. Since many things have been added and changed from the previous version, we believe it is time to once again gather feedback from our users.

We are planning to conduct the second global CBT targeting users in Korea and the U.S., and we plan to gather feedback from users this time as well to further refine and polish the game. We ask for your interest and participation!

[b]Tester Recruitment Period[/b]
[list]
[*] Korea(KST) : ~ Until November 03, 2024 (Thu) 22:00
[*] U.S.(EST) : ~ Until November 03, 2024 (Thu) 08:00
[/list]
[b]How to Apply & Play[/b]

    https://store.steampowered.com/app/3009310/Master_Piece/?l=koreana
    [list]
[*] You can apply for the Playtest by clicking the "Request Access" button at the bottom of the 'Master Piece' Steam store page. 
[*]     Selected testers will receive a "Tester Confirmation Email" sent to the email address registered with Steam. Once you receive the email, the 'Master Piece' game will automatically be added to your Steam Library, and you can start playing immediately.
[*]     [b]Tester confirmation emails will be sent out at the start of the test.[/b]
[/list]

[b]Test Period[/b]
[list]
[*]     Korea(KST) : November 4, 2024 (Mon) 11:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 17:00
[*]     U.S.(EST) : November 3, 2024 (Sun) 22:00 ~ November 11, 2024 (Mon) 04:00
[/list]
[b]Test Regions[/b]
    [list]
[*]    South Korea
[*]    United Status
[/list]
If you're interested in more updates and the official release, please show your support by adding the game to your [b]Wishlist[/b]!

Additionally, join the [b]Master Piece Discord[/b] and leave us your sharp feedback!
 Discord Link : https://discord.gg/b5zcqJYb


[b]Special Event[/b]
After the CBT ends, we will select 20 testers who complete the survey distributed through [b]Discord[/b], and they will receive an official Steam key for 'Master Piece.'
